title: Service commitment cancellation within 14 days with like-new equipment return
facts_text: I activated wireless service 10 days ago under a service commitment. I am cancelling today and returning the device in like-new condition with the original packaging. I understand a restocking fee may still apply, but I ask whether the early termination fee is waived.
request: Please waive the early termination fee because I returned the device in time and in like-new condition.

strict.reason: The strict policy applies the commitment and does not waive the early termination fee absent a qualifying exception.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The customer returned the device within 14 days in like-new condition with original packaging, so the early termination fee is waived; a restocking fee may still apply.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: Qualified return facts support an exception, but the ambiguous variant requires review before final determination.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Check that the timing, return condition and packaging details are sufficiently clear for the 14-day service-commitment waiver rule. Restocking fees remain separate from the early termination fee.
